description:
Creates a custom field context.

If `projectIds` is empty, a global context is created. A global context is one that applies to all project. If `issueTypeIds` is empty, the context applies to all issue types.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the custom field.
parameters.name: fieldId

example.description: A context used to define the custom field options for bugs.
example.name: Bug fields context

application/json.example: {"id":"10025","name":"Bug fields context","description":"A context used to define the custom field options for bugs.","projectIds":[],"issueTypeIds":["10010"]}

201.description: Returned if the custom field context is created.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description: Returned if the field, project, or issue type is not found.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Sub-tasks are disabled in Jira. At least one of the issue types is a sub-task."],"errors":{}}

409.description: Returned if the issue type is a sub-task, but sub-tasks are disabled in Jira settings.
